name: nikas
description: DeepSeek language model provider for VS Code Copilot Chat, with configurable vision preprocessing (Gemma 4 via Ollama or Gemini) and automatic restoration of Copilot Chat PDF support

nikas.selectedModel.description: The DeepSeek model to use for chat

enumDescriptions: 4,096 tokens — Minimal, fastest. Good for simple Q&A.
8,192 tokens — Fast, low cost. Balanced for simple Q&A without thinking mode.
16,384 tokens — Default. Thinking mode sweet spot. Reserves ~8K for reasoning + ~8K for visible output.
32,768 tokens — Large responses for complex code generation and analysis.
65,536 tokens — Very long outputs for document generation and large refactors.
131,072 tokens — Extended output for heavy agent sessions.
384,000 tokens — Maximum DeepSeek V4 output capability.
nikas.maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per response. DeepSeek V4 supports up to 384K tokens. When thinking mode is on, choose at least 16K so reasoning tokens don't consume the entire budget.

nikas.apiRetries.description: Retries for transient DeepSeek API/stream failures (mid-stream socket drops like 'terminated', ECONNRESET/ETIMEDOUT, rate limits, temporary 5xx) that happen before any output was emitted. A failure after partial output is never retried — it would duplicate text. Set 0 to disable.

enumDescriptions: Off — fastest, lowest cost, but too little reasoning for reliable tool calling. Invisible helpers always run at off regardless.
Low (default) — the documented floor for tool-calling/agentic coding: light reasoning, fast, good tool reliability.
High — balanced reasoning
Max — best quality for complex agent builds, but slowest and most expensive (verified in weather-app A/B: much better final product, ~5x slower)
nikas.thinkingEffort.description: Thinking/reasoning effort for the executor agent — the fallback when the per-model 'Thinking Effort' dropdown in Copilot Chat's model picker isn't set. Defaults to low — the recommended floor for tool-calling/agentic work (OpenAI reasoning guide: 'none' is for no-tool latency tasks, 'low' is for tool-use/planning/execution-oriented coding). Set to off for max speed / exact upstream Nika behavior, or high/max for more reasoning on complex tasks. On Flash 'low' gives genuinely lighter reasoning; on Pro 'low' is treated as 'high'.

main.description: Main coding agent thinking effort. Leave unset to use nikas.thinkingEffort.

plan.description: Plan agent thinking effort (default max — planning benefits from deep reasoning).

explore.description: Explore/ASK subagent thinking effort (default low — read-only research).

inline.description: Inline chat thinking effort (default low — light, fast edits).

helper.description: Invisible internal helper requests thinking effort (default low).

nikas.agentEfforts.description: Per-agent thinking-effort overrides. Each key maps a Copilot agent to a reasoning effort; only keys you set are applied, absent ones fall back to normal effort resolution (nikas.thinkingEffort). Default: plan=max, explore=low, inline=low, helper=low.

nikas.agentEffortsEnabled.description: Master toggle for the per-agent thinking-effort overrides (nikas.agentEfforts). When ON, every configured agent effort applies (plan=max, explore=low, inline=low, helper=low). When OFF, the Plan and Explore overrides are KEPT but Inline and helper overrides are dropped — those two fall back to nikas.thinkingEffort, so invisible helpers stop burning tokens on extra reasoning. Flip it anytime via the Nikas Manage menu ('Agent Efforts: ...').

nikas.concisePrompt.description: Inject an agent directive into the system prompt that mirrors Copilot's native coding_agent_instructions: persist end-to-end, take action instead of proposing solutions, prefer edit tools, batch tool calls, and always call a tool instead of narrating a plan. Defaults to OFF to match upstream Nika (which has no such directive) — many find the directive too strict. Enable it if you prefer the terse, no-narration agent behavior.

nikas.visionModel.description: Vision model for image preprocessing. Gemini uses Google AI Studio (free tier, needs API key). Gemma 4 runs locally via Ollama (no API key needed).

nikas.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Ollama server URL. Points to localhost by default, but can be any remote Ollama instance (e.g., http://192.168.1.100:11434). Used when vision model is Gemma 4.

enumDescriptions: 32,768 tokens — Minimal, most cost-efficient
65,536 tokens — Small, good for simple Q&A
131,072 tokens — Balanced for most use cases
262,144 tokens — Default. Large, for complex document analysis and long agent sessions
524,288 tokens — Extra large, for very long conversations
950,000 tokens — Maximum (safe): stays under the API's 1,048,576-token hard ceiling even with thinking mode
Legacy — mapped to 950K tokens (the old 1M preset exceeded the API's hard context ceiling)
nikas.contextWindow.description: Maximum input context window. Limits how many tokens of conversation history are sent to DeepSeek. Defaults to 256K. Smaller windows are faster and cheaper; larger windows capture more context. Applies to all models. Note: the API enforces a hard 1,048,576-token total per request, so the largest safe preset is 950K.

nikas.contextReliabilityLimit.description: Reliability ceiling (real tokens) for the ACTIVE context. DeepSeek's coding quality degrades past ~220-260K real tokens (attention degradation / 'lost in the middle'), even on huge windows — so when the conversation crosses this limit the oldest messages are COMPACTED into a session-memory summary instead of being sent raw. The model keeps the newest turns verbatim (the active task) plus a compressed record of everything earlier: sessions can span far more work, reliably. On a window larger than this value (512K/950K) compaction fires at this limit; on a smaller window it fires at the window's edge, replacing blind truncation. Set 0 to disable compaction (pure truncation, exactly like pre-compaction Nikas).

nikas.virtualToolsThreshold.description: Relevance threshold (0 = off) for embedding-matched virtual-tool expansion. Stands in for Copilot Chat's chat.virtualTools.threshold but in units of the built-in lexical matcher (query terms matched in the tool name/description). 1 = at least one query term matched. Higher = fewer, more-confident matches; lower = more tools surfaced.

nikas.copilotKnowledge.description: Enrich what DeepSeek learns about Copilot's native tools. When enabled, DeepSeek receives richer per-tool descriptions (when to use each browser/dev-tools/terminal/file/search tool) so it uses Copilot's native toolset more effectively while staying on Copilot's native agent loop. Tool enrichment only — no behavioral instructions injected. Costs ~50 tokens/request. Default false (Nika parity: pass Copilot's raw tool descriptions through unchanged).

nikas.visionModelKey.description: Composite key (vendor/id) for a Copilot vision model selected via 'Nikas: Choose Vision Model'. When set, overrides nikas.visionModel. Cleared automatically when a native vision model is selected.

nikas.visionSource.description: Source for image descriptions: 'vscode-lm' uses a Copilot model, 'api-endpoint' uses a direct API endpoint.

nikas.pdfVisionFallback.description: When a PDF's local text extraction is sparse (image-based, scanned, or drawing-heavy like floor plans), describe it with the configured vision model (Gemini reads application/pdf natively) and append the visual description to the extracted text. Falls back to plain text when no direct-API Gemini describer is available. Text-rich PDFs are unaffected.

nikas.pdfVisionFallbackMinChars.description: Local text-extraction length (chars) below which a PDF is considered sparse and triggers the Gemini vision fallback. Default 3000 — scanned / image-heavy PDFs (floor plans, scans, drawings) typically extract far less than this even when they contain some text; real text PDFs (contracts, papers) yield far more and stay on fast/free extraction.

nikas.pdfMaxPages.description: Maximum PDF pages extracted when you do NOT request a specific range. Huge PDFs (books, manuals) are hundreds of pages and would blow past the context window (~1K tokens/page). Default 60. Ask for a range in your message (e.g. 'read pages 100-150' or 'עמודים 5 עד 12') to extract just those pages regardless of this cap. Set 0 for unlimited.

nikas.pdfPageNotice.description: When pdfMaxPages truncates a PDF, tell the model how many pages exist and that it can request a specific range. Default true.

enumDescriptions: No logging at all — completely silent
Only errors and API failures
Errors and warnings (misconfigurations, recoverable issues)
Normal operational messages — requests sent, models used, errors
Detailed debugging — full request/response bodies, message dumps
nikas.logLevel.description: Logging verbosity level. Writes to nikas.log in the workspace root. Set to OFF to disable logging entirely. Set to VERBOSE when debugging API issues.

nikas.logMaxSizeMB.description: Max size (MB) of nikas.log before it is rotated to nikas.log.1 (then .2, .3, ...). Set 0 to disable size-based rotation. Prevents the log from growing to gigabytes.

nikas.logMaxFiles.description: How many rotated log files (nikas.log.1, nikas.log.2, ...) to keep before pruning the oldest. Set 0 to keep none (the log is truncated instead of rotated).

nikas.autoPatchCopilot.description: Automatically re-apply the Copilot Chat PDF patches whenever Copilot Chat / VS Code updates wipe them. Disable if you prefer to patch manually.

nikas.copilotMaxFileSizeMB.description: Max file size (MB) Copilot Chat is patched to accept for attachments (the default Copilot limit is 5 MB). Applied when the Copilot Chat bundle is (re-)patched.

nikas.autoReloadAfterPatch.description: Automatically reload the VS Code window right after re-applying Copilot Chat PDF patches (default prompts you instead).

nikas.patchBackupRetention.description: How many timestamped backups of the Copilot Chat bundle to keep before pruning. Set 0 to keep none.

nikas.updateRepo.description: GitHub repo (owner/repo) used by 'Nikas: Check for Updates'. Points at this project's own fork by default.

nikas.autoCheckUpdates.description: Periodically check GitHub for Nikas updates (silent when up-to-date). Set nikas.updateRepo to your own release repo first.

nikas.usageTracking.description: Track token usage and estimated cost per conversation (Nikas: Usage & Cost dashboard + status bar). Purely observational — disabling stops recording and hides the status bar item.

nikas.memoryPersistence.description: Persist session-memory summaries to a per-workspace nikas.md and re-inject them into the matching conversation after a restart. Purely additive — disabling stops saving and injecting without affecting chat behavior.

nikas.contextBudget.description: Context-budget manager: live warnings as the conversation approaches the window, and (when over budget) reclaim tokens by dropping low-value tool output before discarding user context. Purely additive — disabling turns both off.

nikas.contextWarnThreshold.description: Context fill % at which Nikas starts warning that the window is being approached (live budget warning).

nikas.contextCriticalThreshold.description: Context fill % at which Nikas warns that truncation is imminent and early facts are about to be dropped.

nikas.agentCommand.description: Expose the 'Nikas: Run Agent' command, which runs the built-in agent harness loop (category summarizer → tool scoping → model↔tools) on a task in the current workspace. Purely additive — disabling hides the command and never affects normal chat.

nikas.modelRouter.description: DeepSeek model router: when on, cheap internal helper requests (chat titles, git commit messages, todo tracking, etc.) are routed to the faster Flash chat model even when the Pro model is selected. Off by default. Never routes Responses-family model ids to /chat/completions.

nikas.modelRouterMode.description: Model-router mode (only applies when nikas.modelRouter is on): 'helpers-only' routes internal helpers to Flash; 'auto' additionally routes heavy agent tasks (main/plan/explore with 10+ tools) to Pro and quick chats (inline/unknown, no tools) to Flash.

nikas.harnessPermissionGate.description: Fail-closed permission gate for terminal commands run by the built-in agent harness (Nikas: Run Agent): blocks dangerous patterns (root deletes, disk/formatting, env injection, remote launchers, hostile intent) and unrecognized commands before they execute. Never affects Copilot's own permission flow.

nikas.harnessToolCache.description: Cache read-only tool results (read_file / search_text) within a single harness run so identical calls are served from cache instead of re-executed. Disabling restores re-execution of every call.

nikas.visionStructured.description: Use the structured image-extraction prompt (OCR of visible text, tables as markdown, layout, UI elements — no invented content) when describing images via the vision model. Disabling falls back to the generic description prompt.

nikas.maxImagesPerVisionCall.description: Max images per vision-model call. Larger image sets are described in sequential batches and combined, keeping requests under the vision model's per-request image cap.

nikas.applyAgentModelsOnActivate.description: On activation, apply the recommended Copilot agent model assignments (Explore, Plan, Inline Chat → DeepSeek V4 Flash Responses) for any agent the user hasn't configured yet. Idempotent — never overrides an existing choice. Disable to keep agent models untouched on fresh installs.
